comment: The paths that make up the product site, and nothing else. tools/docs/publish_site.py copies only files that match one of these from develop to the branch `site`, and refuses a push to `site` that changes any other file (docs/ci.md, 'Publishing the site between releases'). A pattern is relative to the repository root: `*` matches within one folder name, `**` matches across folders. The `paths:` of .github/workflows/publish-site.yml has to be this same list; tools/ci/test_publish_site.py checks that. Application code, the build files, the workflows and CHANGELOG.md are not site paths, so they reach `site` only with a release.
